svg.font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The nine steps of the Dapr outbox, in the user request flow and the background outbox flow
svg.desc: Two dashed regions side by side, captioned User request processing (sync) and Background outbox processing (async), with a message broker named Internal topic between them and a gold data-store cylinder named State store below it. In the left region, a green hexagon named My app and a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo exchange step one, Save state, and step four, Response. From that sidecar step two, Publish, runs right to the internal topic, and step three, Save state and marker, runs down and across to the state store. In the right region, a second Dapr hexagon takes step five, Consume, from the internal topic and answers with step nine, ACK/NACK; step six, Read marker, and step eight, Delete marker, run down and across to the state store, and step seven, Publish, runs right to a second broker named External topic.
